method_analytical: Fisher z (Bonett-Wright Spearman correction, sigma_z = sqrt(1.06/(n-3)))
method_simulation: bivariate-normal resample, 5000 sims/cell, empirical Spearman vs simulated null
narrative: At n=10, a one-sided Spearman test at α=0.05 has 80% power to detect ρ ≥ 0.748 (Fisher-z analytical). The pre-registered Gate-3 threshold is ρ > 0.5. To reliably detect ρ = 0.5 at 80% power one-sided, the panel needs n ≥ 25 models. The Week-B observation of ρ = 0.327 is therefore not statistically distinguishable from the null at the panel size used; per pre-registration the predictor is demoted to an observation regardless, but reviewers should not interpret 'fail Gate 3' as evidence against ρ ≥ 0.5 in the population — only as failure to reject H0 at this n.
